developer.title: Developer Panel
developer.description: Controls above every business role. Every action here is audited. The server view is read-only.

roles.title: Roles for {name}
roles.description: One primary role, plus any number of extra groups. Saving signs the user out so the change applies cleanly.
roles.warnDeveloper: Developer is full platform control. Grant it only to people you trust with the server.
roles.self: You cannot change your own roles.
roles.toggleDescription: Turn a role on or off. Each switch saves immediately and signs the user out so the change applies cleanly.
roles.primaryHint: A user holds one primary role. Turning another one on replaces it.
roles.warnFounder: Founder / CEO sees the whole business, including payroll. Grant it only to the owner.
roles.signOutNote: Changes are written to the audit log. You cannot change your own roles, and the last Founder or Developer cannot be removed.

forceLogout.title: Emergency: sign everyone out
forceLogout.description: Ends every session in the organisation except yours. Use for a suspected account takeover.

server.readOnly: Read-only snapshot. Restarts and deploys are done through the deployment runbook, not from this panel.

developer.error: That did not go through. Please try again.

guide.intro: What each role gets, which pages are rolled out for it, and how they work. Page lists come from the permission catalogue, so they match what the server enforces.
guide.scopeHint: Scope: Own = their own records, Team = their reports, Organisation = everyone, Summary = names only.
guide.generated: Page access was generated from the permission catalogue on 16 Oct 2026. Use the Access map tab for the live view.
guide.english: This guide is written in English only.
